strategy.brief: Retail-attention contrarian: where headline counts spiked but analyst flow disagrees, side with the flow; avoid names that are only attention. Say which crowd you are fading. Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
